name: Salatet Lubia Be Ain Souda (Black-Eyed Bean Salad)

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
green bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
Persian cucumbers, trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch pieces

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk to combine oil, lime juice, vinegar, shallot, garlic, cumin, paprika, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Add black-eyed peas, cherry tomatoes, green bell pepper, yellow or red bell pepper, cucumbers, olives, and cilantro or parsley; toss to combine. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper.
Cover and refrigerate until flavors meld, at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: Egyptian black-eyed pea salad, black-eyed pea salad, Egyptian bean salad, canned black-eyed peas, make-ahead bean salad, summer bean salad, cumin-lime dressing

description: This Egyptian black-eyed pea salad with cumin-lime dressing is quick, make-ahead–friendly, and loaded with crisp vegetables, briny olives, and herbs.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)

Optional substitutions: distilled white vinegar → red wine vinegar; yellow pepper → red bell pepper; coarsely chopped pitted Kalamata olives → green olives; finely chopped fresh cilantro → parsley

Make-ahead and storage: Dressing can be made up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container.
Salad can be prepared, omitting the herbs, up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. Add herbs just before serving.
Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days, though herbs may become slightly wilted.
author: Nermine Mansour
